lines.text: Laudibus æternis mandantur pofteritatis.
lines.en: They are committed to the eternal praises of posterity.

lines.text: Floreat Hennenbergiadum generoſa potentum,
lines.en: May the noble house of the powerful Hennenbergs flourish,

lines.text: Illuſtrisq́; domus, cuius nunc magnus alumnus
lines.en: and the illustrious house, whose great pupil now

lines.text: Reuera eſt profugis & portus & aura Camænis.
lines.en: is truly both a port and a breeze for the fugitive Muses.

lines.text: T. Celſitudinis
lines.en: Of Your Highness

lines.text: Deditifsimus.
lines.en: the most devoted,

lines.text: Ioachimus Hellerus Noriber-
lines.en: Joachim Heller of Nuremberg,

lines.text: genſium Mathematicus.
lines.en: Mathematician.

lines.text: IN MESSAHALAM ARABEM
lines.en: ON MESSAHALA THE ARAB

lines.text: ad Ioachimum Hellerum Mathematicum,
lines.en: to Joachim Heller the Mathematician,

lines.text: Gaſpar Bruſchius Poëta.
lines.en: Gaspar Bruschius the Poet.

lines.text: Cum non manſerimus quales nos condidit ipſe
lines.en: Since we have not remained such as He Himself created us,

lines.text: Qui mundi Deus hæc omnia regna tenet
lines.en: God, who holds all these kingdoms of the world,

lines.text: Sed patris antiqui ueſtigia fœda ſequentes
lines.en: But following the foul footsteps of the ancient father

lines.text: Infecti uarijs ſimus ubiq; malis:
lines.en: we are infected everywhere with various evils:

lines.text: E' quibus ipſe tamen nos uult emergere rurſus
lines.en: From which, however, He Himself wishes us to emerge again,

lines.text: Pulchra immortalis qui regit aſtra Deus:
lines.en: the immortal God who rules the beautiful stars:

lines.text: Multas inuenit rationes conditor orbis
lines.en: The creator of the world has found many reasons

lines.text: Per quas in uerum nos reuocaret iter.
lines.en: Through which He might call us back to the true path.

lines.text: Principio Gnatum pro nobis tradidit, ille
lines.en: In the beginning He handed over the Son for us, He

lines.text: Vt nobis iterum monſtret ad aſtra uiam,
lines.en: That He might show us again the way to the stars,

lines.text: Mox uerbũ dedit, ut per idipſum etiã omnibus horis
lines.en: Soon He gave the word, so that through it also at all hours

lines.text: Amiſſarum olim commoneamur opum:
lines.en: we might be reminded of the wealth once lost:

lines.text: Vtq́; emendandæ inuitemur ad inclyta uitæ
lines.en: And that we might be invited to the glorious beginnings of a life to be amended,

lines.text: Cœpta, quibus patri haud ſunt mage grata Deo:
lines.en: than which nothing is more pleasing to God the Father:

summary.headline: Poem on Messahala the Arab
summary.text: Dedication to the Hennenberg house by Joachim Heller of Nuremberg, followed by Gaspar Bruschius’s poem “On Messahala the Arab,” invoking Christian redemption, the Son, the true path, and the stars.
